2026_01_BUF_HOU.headline: Buffalo’s protection has to survive Houston’s disruption plan
2026_01_BUF_HOU.paragraph1: Buffalo arrives in Houston with Josh Allen healthy but three contributors — Ty Johnson, Jordan Hancock and T.J. Sanders — carrying questionable designations, while the Texans have no listed game-status injuries. That availability edge matters in a matchup where Houston can make Allen work through pressure rather than live on improvised explosives. Buffalo’s answer is to stay efficient before third down and protect long enough for routes to develop. Houston’s defense can control the tempo if it repeatedly turns Allen into a late-down problem solver.
2026_01_BUF_HOU.model_rationale: Buffalo’s offensive ceiling remains formidable, but Houston can compress the matchup by winning protection downs, limiting Allen’s escape lanes and forcing the Bills to sustain patient drives.
